_: Days that carry more calls than a day is budgeted for, and cards a campaign
serves twice. Same two properties as concept-debt.json and equation-debt.json:
a row not on this list fails immediately, so nothing new drifts in, and a row
on the list that has since been fixed also fails, naming the line to delete, so
the file cannot become a standing excuse. It only shrinks.
This key is the header. It is not data - counting these lines as debt is how a
total reads high for an afternoon.
It holds no rows. The duplicate half started at 295 across 27 campaigns and is
empty because shapeMissions no longer adds a callback it would have to re-serve
a card to fill. The over-4 half started at 72 days and is empty because five
books were re-dayed: instruments split its arcade and world-format days rather
than dropping a format nothing else authors, Project Y moved its acceptance
criteria onto the uncertainty-budget day, and the two grade-6 editions sent
eight stops to the days their subject actually belongs to. One stop was
deleted and then put back, because the two candidates for redundant looked
alike in their scenes and claimed different concepts - which is this repo's
own rule about a plausible measurement, arriving in the editorial half.
